name: Misato (Miyagi, Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Misato town emblem in green and grey: two interlocking green rings of different shades.
history: Municipal flag of Misato, a town in Miyagi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 29 July 2006.

features.role: Misato town emblem — two interlocking green rings of different shades
